verdict.rationale: Once a user sets up the Gusto integration, it syncs hiring, onboarding and equity data and automatically grants equity from offer-letter promises. The data room also collects documents behind the scenes as workflows complete. These are fixed, vendor-defined automations rather than user-configurable ones, and the API/OpenAPI probes found nothing to build custom automations on. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules, triggers or schedules, an API or webhooks for custom background jobs, and independent corroboration.
